ticket.summary: Homeowner requesting quote for proactive replacement of 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater in garage at 61 Foxtail Dr.; wants written quote and permit fee from office, no scheduling yet.
mitigation_advice: If the tank begins leaking or overheating: turn the gas control dial to OFF, close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank, and do not drain it yourself [PB-04]

quote_lines.description: 40-gal gas water heater replacement (like-for-like swap; includes tank, old unit removal/disposal, standard supply lines, gas connector and shutoff). Excludes venting upgrades, expansion tank, pan/drain if required by code, and municipal permit fee (passed through at cost).

ticket.customer_message: Perfect — 61 Foxtail Dr., garage install, noted. I'll pass this to the office as a quote request so they can send you the written quote with the permit fee for your city and a firm price window. No appointment booked; just reach out when you're ready and we'll schedule (plan on about 4.5 hours on site). One thing to file away: if the tank ever starts leaking or overheating before then, turn the gas control dial to OFF and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank — don't try to drain it yourself — then call us [PB-04].
